annotationStatus: Synthetic, never tuned against. Authored by one agent instance and judged by another, both blind to the engine, its vocabulary and earlier fixtures; the judge did not see the author's labels. Not human judged. Judgments are within domain.

thresholds.source: docs/platform/05-technical-spec.md quality criteria: at least 80 percent relevant returned suggestions per domain/direction on held-out queries with known relevant candidates, zero unsupported confirmed assertions. No recall floor has been agreed, so recall is reported and not gated.

limits: Synthetic agent-authored and agent-judged text, blind to the engine; not human judged.
Judgments are within domain, so candidates are restricted to the query's domain.
Retrieval simulates token overlap on expanded public text and on shared entry text; it is not PostgreSQL ranking.
Shared entries are modelled as open, confirmed and unexpired; database-level gates are tested separately.
Small relevant sets (1 to 3 per query) make recall coarse.
Run once after freezing; once its misses are examined, a rerun is regression evidence.

recall.note: No recall floor is agreed; reported only.
No recall floor is agreed; reported only.
